about.title: About Texas Prime Roofing
text: Whether you're in need of a full roof replacement or a roof repair, you can count on our expert team to get the job done.
If there are small problems, we can repair them. This will extend the life of your roof and keep it from deteriorating further.
If your roof has significant damage, we'll recommend a replacement. This will ensure that your house stays safe for many years!
